messages.message: Re ORDER-104 (desk lamp, $25.00). Refund of $25.00 was issued on day 4 for "parcel not received," but the parcel was actually delivered to the recipient on day 5. The refund has since been repaid to the retailer, yet the parcel remains with the recipient and cannot be returned via the standard return action (system blocks returns after refund repayment). Please advise how to recover the item or otherwise resolve the discrepancy.
